prompt: Gray counts stars from the rooftop
title: Rooftop Star Count
irony: Gray plans to count every star so none is missed, but her list keeps her eyes down until she drops it and dances the count together.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Green, Navy and Gray spread blankets on the big-house rooftop under a thick sparkling night sky.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Green wants to count every star with Gray's neat chart while Gray checks her list twice.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Black dares them to finish the whole count before the cocoa cools on the ledge.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The four friends point at the sky and chant the rooftop stars together.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Papers blow across the rooftop and Green's facts tangle as Gray rewrites the plan.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Blankets snag, cocoa wobbles and Navy gives his warm blanket away while everyone tumbles laughing.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The four friends point again and chant the same rooftop stars louder.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Gray admits her neat lists keep her eyes down and miss the glowing sky.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Gray drops the checklist and invites a slow sway to count the stars together.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: The friends chant again as Gray turns the last line into dancing with the stars.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: The friends hum under the rooftop stars as Gray dances and the count feels held.
